messages:
Michelle: Noticing several customers reporting delayed webhook callbacks and 502s starting ~05:07 UTC. Opening thread to coordinate CS outreach + interim mitigations.
Arjun: Looking at traces now. Seems like a sudden spike in retries from a third-party integrator caused surge on route-service. Latency climbed and some upstreams returned 502s due to queue saturation.
Jamal: Confirmed. queue_length peaked ~1400 on route-service, eviction thrash on KV cache. No code deploys at the time. Suggest immediate rate-limiting on ingress and lowering upstream timeout while we drain backlog.
ops-bot: autoscale action triggered for route-service -> scaled +30% replicas.
Arjun: Applied ingress rate-limit (global 50rps burst 200) at 05:18 UTC and reduced upstream timeout 60s -> 12s. 502s dropped quickly.
Michelle: Drafting customer-facing note. Keep it concise, apology + what we did + next steps + offer. Draft: "Hi <Customer>, we observed intermittent webhook callback failures (502) between 05:07
05:22 UTC impacting delivery to some integrations. We applied temporary rate limiting and configuration changes to reduce retries and restore throughput. Deliveries have resumed for most tenants; remaining queued callbacks will complete within 45 minutes. We'll follow up with a detailed RCA and next steps to prevent recurrence. As a courtesy we are issuing a credit for the impacted window and can schedule a 30-minute enablement session to review webhook best practices. \u2014 Michelle (CS)"
Elaine: Language sounds good. For renewal-risk accounts, propose 25% credit + priority enablement. For self-serve, a smaller token (10%). I'll pull the impacted account list and tag high-risk ones.
Jamal: Short RCA summary for customers: root cause was an external client retry loop that amplified traffic into route-service; mitigations: ingress rate-limiting, upstream timeout reduction, added per-tenant circuit-breaker and temporary worker scaling. A full postmortem will include timeline, metrics, and config patches.
Michelle: I'll send the bulk note to the low-touch list now and personalize the high-touch templates. Sending to ~22 affected tenants.
Arjun: Current dashboard: error rate from route-service is down to 1.6% (was 18% at peak). Backlog drained to <2% of peak queue length. We'll maintain alerting for 3 hours.
Elaine: Scheduling enablement webinars starting tomorrow. I'll include a short playbook: exponential backoff, idempotency keys, webhook batching options, and suggested headers.
Jamal: Adding a quick ops excerpt for the RCA: 
```
[05:12:41] route-service WARN queue_length=1398 retries=420 source=partner-proxy
[05:17:02] ingress ERROR upstream_timeout tenant=acct-9876 req_id=xyz-123
[05:18:30] infra INFO rate_limit_applied global=50rps
[05:22:11] monitors INFO queue_drain=95%
```
Michelle: Good. Once CS notes go out I'll post an executive summary to #cs-incident-communications and attach the RCA draft.
ops-bot: incident-record updated: incident_id=INC-2400123456 status=mitigated assigned=[Arjun,Jamal]
Elaine: I'll send the segmented account list + templated personalized notes in ~10m.
Michelle: Thanks team. Closing thread for now; will reopen if we see any regression.
